WITH invoice_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    o.order_id,
    COUNT(i.invoice_number) as invoice_count
  FROM Orders o
  LEFT JOIN Invoices i ON o.order_id = i.order_id
  GROUP BY o.order_id
),
total_count AS (
  SELECT CAST(COUNT(*) as DECIMAL(19,4)) as total 
  FROM Invoices
),
order_shares AS (
  SELECT 
    ic.order_id,
    ic.invoice_count,
    CASE 
      WHEN (SELECT total FROM total_count) = 0 THEN 0
      ELSE CAST(ic.invoice_count as DECIMAL(19,4)) / (SELECT total FROM total_count)
    END as share
  FROM invoice_counts ic
),
average_share AS (
  SELECT AVG(share) as avg_share 
  FROM order_shares
),
above_average AS (
  SELECT 
    os.order_id,
    os.invoice_count,
    os.share
  FROM order_shares os
  WHERE os.share > (SELECT avg_share FROM average_share)
)
SELECT 
  SUM(invoice_count) as total_invoices,
  AVG(share) as average_share,
  AVG(share - (SELECT avg_share FROM average_share)) as average_excess
FROM above_average
